emergencyBar: Emergency? 119 Fire / Ambulance · 110 Police (free, 24h, interpretation available)

notices.medical: This may be a medical emergency. Call 119 now for an ambulance — free, 24h, interpretation available.
notices.police: If you are in danger right now, call 110 (police) immediately — free, 24h, interpretation available.
notices.fire: If there is a fire, call 119 now — free, 24h, interpretation available. Get to a safe place first.
